name: daviddtech-looks
description: Animated looks for the Claude desktop and mobile apps: a winter night with snow and lights, a market weather sky that follows the DaviddTech+ storm levels, and a pine forest that pulses red or green after a DaviddTech Aid check.

aidStatus.title: Aid check in the status line
aidStatus.description: on shows the last DaviddTech Aid check (red, orange, yellow or clean, and the score) in the status line; off leaves the status line alone. The pine look still pulses either way.
